fields.name: TargetValue
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18F69D0 creates the component with 0.0. bg3.exe+0x18EB8C0 copies the first 8 bytes of the per-entity fade request (16-byte values of a HashMap<EntityHandle, request> in ecl::TimelineFadeRequestsSingletonComponent) here on every request, and copies this value into +0x0C when the request is immediate - so +0 is the value being faded to and +0x0C the value reached so far. Live: 0.0 (faded out).

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: Default 4.0 in bg3.exe+0x18F69D0; overwritten from the second float of the fade request in bg3.exe+0x18EB8C0. Live: 4.0. Probably the fade speed, but no reader was found.

fields.name: Immediate
fields.evidence: Default 0; copied from byte 8 of the request. When set, bg3.exe+0x18EB8C0 writes TargetValue into CurrentValue at once instead of leaving the fade to run. Live: 1.

fields.name: field_9
fields.evidence: Default 0 (one 16-bit store with +8); copied from byte 9 of the request. Live: 1.

fields.name: field_A
fields.evidence: Default 1; copied from byte 10 of the request, which bg3.exe+0x18EB8C0 also forwards (with a 'fully faded out at once' flag) into a second per-entity request map. Live: 0.

fields.name: _PadB
fields.evidence: copied with the request's padding; live 0x33 garbage

fields.name: CurrentValue
fields.evidence: Default 1.0; set to TargetValue by bg3.exe+0x18EB8C0 when Immediate is set. Live: 0.0.

fields.name: Active
fields.evidence: Default 1; bg3.exe+0x18EB8C0 sets 1 when a request arrives (0 only when a new component is created by an immediate request on an entity that already had the fade tag), and writes 0 when the entity is in the 'remove fade' list (it then also removes ecl::TimelineFadeActiveView1Component). Live: 1.

fields.name: _Pad11
fields.evidence: tail padding to 20 bytes (alignment 4); live FF FF FF

open_questions: Names only: field_4 (probably the fade speed), field_9 and field_A are unnamed because the consumer that blends the ecl::*FadeView1Component sources into ls::FadingView1Component (system bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0) was not read.
Whether the value is an opacity (1 = visible) - consistent with the defaults, not proven.
same_as: ecl::TimelineFadeView0Component - the two creation helpers (bg3.exe+0x18F6530 and bg3.exe+0x18F69D0) are identical apart from the type index (same size 0x14, same default stores), and the two system functions bg3.exe+0x18EB2D0 / bg3.exe+0x18EB8C0 differ only in which request map of the singleton they read (+0x00.. vs +0x40..)
second_pass: Re-read the Windows creator bg3.exe+0x18F69D0: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(0x14), stores 0.0 at +0, 4.0 at +4, a 16-bit 0 at +8, byte 1 at +0x0A, 1.0 at +0x0C and byte 1 at +0x10 - every offset and width is the same as in the confirmed ecl::TimelineFadeView0Component, so the layout is settled from code; only three names stay open.
